nodes.title: How to read it
widgets_values:
Reference images: one Run, every combination.

The carry links WScheduler, WSampler, WInt and WLoRA like the digits of a counter: when one finishes its list, the next moves by one. Here 4 schedulers x 2 samplers x 2 seeds x 4 LoRAs = 64 runs: set the Run count to 64.
WSave Image writes into every file name the values that made that image; WDifference lists what changed from the run before.

Model and LoRA names are examples: pick your own in WCheckpoint and WLoRA.
